This demo post shows the Description List Block. Click into a list below to edit it, or add a new one with the block inserter.

Block style: Indent

Description list
A list of terms and their descriptions, marked up with the semantic dl, dt and dd elements.
Term (dt)
The name or term being described. Colour, spacing, indent, font size, font style and font weight can be set separately for terms.
Description (dd)
The description belonging to the term above. Add, insert or delete term and description pairs right from the block toolbar.

Block style: Grid

Indent
The default block style. The description is indented relative to its term.
Grid
Terms and descriptions are laid out in two columns. The column width is adjustable.
Disable Block CSS
Removes the block styling so your theme takes over completely.

Tip: select a paragraph, a list or an HTML block and transform it into a description list — and back again — from the block toolbar.
